verdict: Organic traffic softened this week; no paid ads are active.
narrative: Your business is running on organic channels only right now — no paid ads ran on Meta or Google over the last 28 days, so your Google Business Profile and direct site traffic are carrying all the load. GBP engagement dropped 50% over the past week compared to the week before, with the last three days showing no recorded actions; this points to either a dip in local search visibility or seasonal softening in demand. Website sessions also slid 21% week-over-week, though the most recent few days ticked back up slightly. We're monitoring the GBP drop closely and evaluating whether reactivating paid search makes sense to stabilize lead flow. If organic engagement doesn't recover on its own, a paid channel reactivation is the clearest lever available.
